name: Date time day
description: Field type storing a date plus a start and end time on that same day.
project_description:
🇺🇦

Please consider supporting Ukraine in a fight for their freedom and safety of Europe. 
 
 
 Date time day provides the ability to store start, end times of the single day.

 Requirements 
 This module requires the following modules:

 
 Field (Drupal core) 
 Datetime (Drupal core) 
 
 Installation 
 
 Download and enable as normal module 
 
 Configuration 
 You could configure form view mode and display view mode, like in any standard field. See Field UI help for more details.

 Uninstalling 
 
 Remove all dependend fields, otherwise you won't be able to uninstall it. 
 Uninstall as a normal module.
